Message.Name: Simple Instrument Definition Message
Message.Description: used to disseminate all Simple Instruments traded on MIAX FuturesOnyx for the current trading session

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Matching Engine time

Field.Name: Instrument Id
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by MIAX Futures Onyx

Field.Description: Indicates whether the Instrument ID has been assigned by the exchange or from an external industry source

Field.Description: ‘F’ = Futures

Field.Description: Maturity Month-Year is the expiration date of a Simple Instrument

Field.Description: The currency in which all Futures Instruments of the Futures Product will trade

Field.Name: Settlement Currency
Field.Description: The Currency in which the Product settles

Field.Description: The allocation model used by the MIAX Futures Onyx Trading Platform for the Product

Field.Name: Minimum Size
Field.Description: Minimum Order Size

Field.Name: Maximum Size
Field.Description: Maximum Order Size

Field.Name: Tick
Field.Description: Order Entry Price Tick of the Product

Field.Name: Unit of Measure
Field.Description: Individual unit of the Deliverable of the Underlying Asset associated with the Futures Contract

Field.Name: Unit of Measure Quantity
Field.Description: The quantity of the Underlying Asset that is required for the Deliverable associated with the Futures Contract

Field.Name: Settlement Price
Field.Description: The previous day’s Settlement Price

Field.Name: Settlement Price Type Calc Method
Field.Description: Actual or Theoretical Settlement Price Indicator

Field.Name: Total Volume
Field.Description: The aggregate amount of volume that has traded from the prior Trading Day

Field.Name: Open Interest Quantity
Field.Description: The amount of aggregate open contracts in a Simple Instrument

Field.Name: High Limit Price
Field.Description: The Upper Band of the Daily Trading Limit of a Futures Product

Field.Name: Low Limit Price
Field.Description: The Lower Band of the Daily Trading Limit of a Futures Product

Field.Name: Trading Collar Variation Type
Field.Description: Trading Collar Variation Type

Field.Name: Trading Collar Variation
Field.Description: The Dollar Value or Percentage Value used in the calculation of theTrading Collar

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use
